\[
2 \times (\text{length} + \text{width}) = 36
\]

Since the length of the rectangle is 11 cm and the width is 7 cm (since the perimeter formula simplifies to 36 cm when the length and width are such that the sum of the lengths plus the widths equals the perimeter):

\[
\text{Length} + \text{Width} = \frac{36}{2} = 18

\[
\text{Length} = 11 \, \text{cm}, \quad \text{Width} = 7 \, \text{cm}
\]

The area is calculated as:

\[
\text{Area} = \text{length} \times \text{width} = 11 \, \text{cm} \times 7 \, \text{cm} = 77 \, \text{cm}^2
\]

Thus, the area of the rectangle is \(\boxed{77}\).
